data.title: ECC raises wheat import ceiling to 2.5 million t as PBS flour jumps 5.7% in a week
data.summary: The ECC on 27 Nov approved in principle raising the 2026-27 wheat import limit from 1.0 to 2.5 million t (Punjab 950,000 t, Sindh 450,000 t, KP 300,000 t; provinces pay full cost), pending cabinet ratification. PBS put the 20 kg flour bag at Rs3,277.56 in the week to 26 Nov, up 5.72% on the week and 53.5% on the year.

data.why: AMIS Punjab wheat eased to Rs126.9/kg on 27 Nov (12 mandis) from Rs130.6/kg on 26 Nov, but flour is still climbing: PBS put the 20 kg bag at Rs3,277.56 in the week to 26 Nov, up 5.7% on the week and 53.5% on the year. The ECC on 27 Nov raised the wheat import ceiling to 2.5 million t (Punjab 950,000 t), which will not land in volume for weeks, so mills and bran stay tight through winter until the April harvest.
data.act: Cover winter wanda needs for 30–45 days now with quotes from two flour mills, in one lot rather than tranches; use the small dip in mandi wheat since 24 Nov to press for bran at or below last week's price before flour-led increases pass through.

data.refreshNote: No new AMIS maize or wheat date since the afternoon run (maize still 28 Nov, wheat 27 Nov) and no confirmed 27 Nov CBOT settlements, interbank close or new PBS fertiliser week found; added the ECC 2.5 million t wheat import ceiling and PBS flour +5.7% and refreshed the wheat bran view. Kissan Cares rice rows remain generic paddy.
